report_card.goal: Create the skill-feedback pattern ledger v2 implementation plan from the brainstorm requirements.

friction.note: Codex lifecycle hook support superseded the prior notifier assumption, so current official docs had to be checked before planning. Doc review also exposed the need for a hard trusted-skill-identity gate before ledger work.

verification_burden.note: Validated frontmatter, artifact hygiene, origin fidelity, official Codex hook docs, and headless document review findings.

target.value: Codex lifecycle hook trusted skill identity

observations.summary: The plan now blocks downstream ledger work unless a structured engine-owned skill identity source is found and proven.
Official Codex docs now support lifecycle hooks, including Stop, so notifier-era capture is no longer the proof path.

evidence_gaps.message: Closeout could not read skill version.
Closeout has no trusted runtime model source.
Closeout did not include an explicit skill run id.
Skill-attributed cost is unavailable in v1.
